name: security-reviewer-starter
description: Starter Track: a security reviewer for every GitHub pull request on Cloudflare Workers + Workers AI (free plan). Lives in its own directory so the Deploy to Cloudflare button can target it.

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Any long random string. Type the same value into your GitHub webhook's Secret field.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token for the repos to review: Pull requests (read and write), Commit statuses (read and write), Contents (read).
